speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe your physical examination findings in detail, as the combination of fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and abnormal exam results is concerning for a serious underlying condition. Do you have any known lumps, swollen glands, or changes in your skin or eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history; given your age and significant weight loss despite a good appetite, we must rule out malignancy. Do you notice any night sweats, fevers, or a persistent cough? Also, can you tell me if you have experienced any bone pain or changes in bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (Burkitt's Lymphoma)

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH), and Abdominal Ultrasound.
